prompts.enemyMeleePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art BODY sprite sheet for a top-down 2.5D survival game, NOT an illustration.
Create ONE transparent PNG sheet for one character: a lean scavenger melee raider wearing a sand-brown hooded work jacket, rolled dark trouser cuffs, battered boots, tape at sleeves, a conspicuous off-white woven shoulder sack slung diagonally. Slight forward hunch. Muted weathered coastal palette, sand #ab9370, dark brown outlines, warm gray fabric. Realistic adult proportions, small head, restrained low-resolution pixel clusters, consistent soft upper-left light. Not cute/chibi, not smooth painted, no outlines thicker than one logical pixel.
Exact layout: FIVE equal columns and FIVE equal rows. Canvas 1280 by 1920 if possible, each cell 256 by 384, representing a 32 by 48 logical-pixel sprite at exactly 8x nearest-neighbor enlargement. No gutters, no labels, no grid lines. Every sprite shares the same bottom-center foot anchor within its cell, boots' soles at logical y=47, body centered x=16, head near y=8. Character fills approximately 20 logical pixels wide and 39 high. Every complete body remains inside its cell.
Rows top-to-bottom face EAST (screen-right profile), SOUTHEAST (down-right three-quarter), SOUTH (front toward viewer), NORTHEAST (up-right rear three-quarter), NORTH (back away). ALL five columns in a row keep precisely that direction.
Columns left-to-right: 0 idle feet planted; 1 walk left foot forward/right back; 2 walk passing pose; 3 walk right foot forward/left back; 4 opposite passing pose. Subtle 1-pixel body bob, identical clothing and scale in all 25 frames, no sliding anchors.
BODY LAYER ONLY: head/hood/neck, torso, shoulder sack, pelvis, legs and boots. NO arms below the shoulder and NO hands: the game supplies articulated arms and a separate club. No held weapons. Do not draw club, shadows, ground, environment, blood, text, border, watermarks or extra objects. Background must be truly transparent, not a checkerboard. Do not crop any frame.
prompts.enemyMeleeAlphaPrompt: Edit this sprite sheet only by removing the entire brown gradient background, including all spaces between legs and straps, to genuine alpha transparency. Keep every character pixel, all 25 poses, the exact 5-column 5-row layout, existing dimensions, direction order, body scale, colors, and positions unchanged. No background color, no checkerboard rendered into the file, no replacement backdrop, no shadow. This must be a usable transparent PNG sprite sheet; keep the character edges clean.
prompts.enemyGunnerPrompt:
Edit the attached production sprite sheet into a different role: a scavenger PISTOL GUNNER. Preserve the exact 5-column by 5-row layout, 25 body poses, direction order E/SE/S/NE/N, foot anchors, adult proportions, lighting and muted coastal pixel-art family. Replace the hooded sack carrier in EVERY cell with the same stockier, broad-shouldered gunner: faded rust-orange sleeveless work vest over a dark charcoal shirt torso, short patchy hair and a low dark wool cap, a simple patched chest rig with two bulky ammunition pouches, dark gray trousers and black work boots. No large sack and no hood. Warm rust fabric and broad squared vest must distinguish this character from the lean sand hood raider at 32x48 game resolution. Keep expressive chunky shapes, reduce fine noisy texture; practical low-resolution sprite readability, no chibi head.
BODY LAYER ONLY: head/neck, torso with vest/pouches, pelvis and legs. NO arms below shoulders, NO hands, NO held pistol or weapon; articulated arms and weapons are separate game layers. All 25 frames are the SAME character. Row order and gait columns identical to source. Keep each complete body inside its equal cell. No labels, grid lines, ground shadow, backdrop, border or text. Genuine alpha transparent background including between feet.
prompts.enemyLookoutPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied 5 by 5 production body sprite sheet to make one different game role: a lean lookout, in every cell. Preserve the exact 25 poses and direction order E, SE, S, NE, N, the five gait columns, adult proportions and bottom-centre foot anchors. Same coastal muted pixel-art family, clear large shapes readable at 32x48 pixels. Replace the sand hood and large sack with a slim SHORT faded blue-gray work jacket, a small close-fitting dark satchel, dark trousers and battered boots, a low peaked cap (no hood). One small old radio is clipped high on the torso, its short antenna clearly visible above one shoulder; binoculars hang against the chest. Light thin silhouette, no large backpack. BODY LAYER ONLY: head/neck, torso, pelvis and legs, shoulders end at sleeves; NO hands or arms below shoulders, NO held weapon. All 25 cells have the same lookout and consistent scale. Preserve exact row/column positions; complete bodies stay inside cells. No labels, ground, shadows, border or text. Genuine alpha transparent background and transparent gaps between limbs. Intended runtime export is 32x48 per cell with body 39px high.
prompts.enemyMeleeCorpsePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game corpse sprite matching the sand-brown hooded raider in the attached body-sheet reference. Same hood, off-white woven shoulder sack, dark rolled trousers, battered brown boots, slim adult proportions, coastal weathered pixel-art family. A full body lying motionless on its side on the ground, viewed from the game's top-down 2.5D camera; HEAD points EAST (right), feet left, torso subtly foreshortened. Arms present and naturally folded/relaxed close to torso; no held club or weapon, no detached objects. Non-graphic, no blood or wounds. One character only, centred with generous transparent margin on all sides, horizontal silhouette, width about twice height. Designed to be exported at 48x32 logical pixels with centre anchor. Clear large pixel-art clusters, no noisy texture. No ground, no shadow, text, border or background. TRUE ALPHA transparency.
